Dead Drow is in the torchstalk gulch area of the Underdark during Act One.

Involvement

Act One

The dead drow was climbing the mushrooms to the secret fairy rings. He threw his backpack onto each platform to check which were safe to jump on, but fell when a platform magically dispelled from his weight.

Speak with Dead

The dead drow can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Dead Drow
      House Vandree... far scout... searching...
      • What where you searching for?
        • Dead Drow
          Quick path... to surface...
  • What happened to you?
    • Dead Drow
      Threw backpack... too light... fell...
      • How did throwing a backpack make you fall?
        • Dead Drow
          Mushrooms... disappear... guessed wrong...
  • Did you have any allies nearby?
    • Dead Drow
      Worked alone... better that way...
